import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static long N, K;
    static Matrix[][] mat;

    static long beki(long a, long b) {
        long res = 1;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) != 0) res = (res * a) % MOD;
            a = (a * a) % MOD;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static class Matrix {
        long[][] A;
        int n, m;

        Matrix(int n, int m) {
            this.n = n;
            this.m = m;
            A = new long[n][m];
        }

        Matrix(int n) {
            this(n, n);
        }

        static Matrix identity(int n) {
            Matrix mat = new Matrix(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) mat.A[i][i] = 1;
            return mat;
        }

        Matrix add(Matrix B) {
            assert n == B.n && m == B.m;
            Matrix C = new Matrix(n, m);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++)
                    C.A[i][j] = (A[i][j] + B.A[i][j]) % MOD;
            return C;
        }

        Matrix subtract(Matrix B) {
            assert n == B.n && m == B.m;
            Matrix C = new Matrix(n, m);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++)
                    C.A[i][j] = (A[i][j] - B.A[i][j] + MOD) % MOD;
            return C;
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix B) {
            assert m == B.n;
            Matrix C = new Matrix(n, B.m);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
                for (int j = 0; j < B.m; j++)
                    for (int k = 0; k < m; k++)
                        C.A[i][j] = (C.A[i][j] + A[i][k] * B.A[k][j]) % MOD;
            return C;
        }

        Matrix pow(long k) {
            Matrix result = identity(n);
            Matrix base = this;
            while (k > 0) {
                if ((k & 1) != 0) result = result.multiply(base);
                base = base.multiply(base);
                k >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }

        long determinant() {
            Matrix B = new Matrix(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
                System.arraycopy(A[i], 0, B.A[i], 0, n);
            long ret = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                int idx = -1;
                for (int j = i; j < n; j++) {
                    if (B.A[j][i] != 0) {
                        idx = j;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (idx == -1) return 0;
                if (i != idx) {
                    ret = (ret * (MOD - 1)) % MOD;
                    long[] tmp = B.A[i];
                    B.A[i] = B.A[idx];
                    B.A[idx] = tmp;
                }
                ret = (ret * B.A[i][i]) % MOD;
                long vv = B.A[i][i];
                long inv = beki(vv, MOD - 2);
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    B.A[i][j] = (B.A[i][j] * inv) % MOD;
                }
                for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
                    long a = B.A[j][i];
                    if (a == 0) continue;
                    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                        B.A[j][k] = (B.A[j][k] - B.A[i][k] * a) % MOD;
                        if (B.A[j][k] < 0) B.A[j][k] += MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            return ret;
        }

        void rot() {
            int size = (int)K + 1;
            Matrix B = new Matrix(size);
            for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                    B.A[i][j] = A[(i + (int)K - 1) % (int)K][(j + (int)K - 1) % (int)K];
                }
                B.A[i][(int)K] = A[(i + (int)K - 1) % (int)K][(int)K];
                B.A[(int)K][i] = A[(int)K][(i + (int)K - 1) % (int)K];
            }
            B.A[(int)K][(int)K] = A[(int)K][(int)K];
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                System.arraycopy(B.A[i], 0, A[i], 0, size);
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextLong();
        K = sc.nextLong();
        long INDEX = 0;
        long copy = N;
        while (copy >= K) {
            INDEX++;
            copy /= K;
        }
        int idx = (int)INDEX;
        int k = (int)K;
        mat = new Matrix[idx + 1][k];
        mat[0][0] = Matrix.identity(k + 1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            mat[0][0].A[0][i] = 1;
        }
        for (int i = 1; i < k; i++) {
            mat[0][i] = new Matrix(k + 1);
            for (int r = 0; r <= k; r++) {
                System.arraycopy(mat[0][i-1].A[r], 0, mat[0][i].A[r], 0, k+1);
            }
            mat[0][i].rot();
        }
        for (int index = 1; index <= idx; index++) {
            mat[index][0] = new Matrix(k + 1);
            for (int r = 0; r <= k; r++) {
                System.arraycopy(mat[index-1][0].A[r], 0, mat[index][0].A[r], 0, k+1);
            }
            for (int i = 1; i < k; i++) {
                mat[index][0] = mat[index-1][i].multiply(mat[index][0]);
            }
            for (int i = 1; i < k; i++) {
                mat[index][i] = new Matrix(k + 1);
                for (int r = 0; r <= k; r++) {
                    System.arraycopy(mat[index][i-1].A[r], 0, mat[index][i].A[r], 0, k+1);
                }
                mat[index][i].rot();
            }
        }
        Matrix ans = new Matrix(k + 1, 1);
        ans.A[k][0] = 1;
        int used = 0;
        while (idx >= 0) {
            for (int i = 0; ; i++) {
                long powVal = beki(K, idx);
                if (powVal <= N) {
                    N -= powVal;
                    ans = mat[idx][used].multiply(ans);
                    used++;
                    used %= k;
                } else break;
            }
            idx--;
        }
        long val = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            val = (val + ans.A[i][0]) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(val);
        sc.close();
    }
}
